message: LoRA adds a small gain; descriptors lead at 500 labels
caption: Pooled held-out scores, 3,344 compounds once per method and budget. N100 = 80 FIT + 20 CAL; N500 = 400 FIT + 100 CAL per fold, one draw and seed; five reused strict-chemical development folds, not independent replicates or a fresh holdout. Both neural arms used 40 full-FIT updates with matched optimizer; controls had different tuning procedures. Errors use weights 1/max(reported assay SE, 0.1); lower weighted MAE is better.
design: Aligned method dot plots on a shared error scale compare the matched neural gain with practical controls; no bars on a truncated baseline.
